newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman's 1995 M2 money supply grows yr/yr 7.7 pct [CORRECTED 14:45 GMT].
newsitem.headline: Oman's 1995 M2 money supply grows yr/yr 7.7 pct [CORRECTED 14:45 GMT].

text.p: Oman's M2 money supply rose 7.7 percent in 1995, Oman News Agency reported, quoting the central bank.
M1 fell 0.4 percent in 1995 after expanding 4.6 percent in 1994, it said.
